sources.note: Custom track (Track Central) of one giant wooden staircase, PS4 share capture, clean frame, in-game HUD (fault count + timer) top-left.

clips.source_title: Bunny Hop - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 7
clips.what: Two D2-checkpoint attempts back to back: rider on ledge from previous try, hard-cut reset to D2 at +2.0s (camera snaps wide->tight), stationary bunny hop from plank onto container ledge at +3.5s (crouch 0.4s, airtime ~0.6s), rides off, second reset at +7.0s.

clips.source_title: Bunny Hop - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 7
clips.what: Same D2 stationary hop repeated: rider pre-loads for 2.5s, hops at +3.0s and lands back on the plank (short hop), settles; includes an editor dissolve at +2.5s (source video edit, not game).

clips.source_title: Rear Wheel Bounce - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 11
clips.what: Reset to tight cam at +0.5s, rider manuals off a ledge on the rear wheel and lands on a hanging crate at +1.5s, holds rear-wheel balance on the crate for ~4s (bike ~70 deg pitch, small pitch oscillation), then drops off at +6s (cam widens).

clips.source_title: Rear Wheel Bounce - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 11
clips.what: Rear-wheel hops across a row of vertical pole tops climbing toward a higher platform (0-4.5s), then hard-cut reset to C1 (+5.0s) and re-approach.

clips.source_title: Uphill Obstacles - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 8
clips.what: Climb up a curved quarter-pipe (C3 zone), drop onto container top with the B grade plaque, flame-jet pyro fires at +6.0s when the grade zone is cleared.

clips.source_title: Uphill Obstacles - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 8
clips.what: Rider stalls near the top of a ~60 deg plank and rolls back (0-2s); from +2.5s the camera is at its widest as the rider grinds up a very long straight plank at roughly one bike length per second.

clips.source_title: Uphill Landing - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 6
clips.what: Slow climb of a steep plank with visible exhaust puffs on throttle blips (0-4s), launch at +4.5s, camera pulls back during flight, rear-wheel landing on the D1 platform at +5.5s, checkpoint pyro at +6s.

clips.source_title: Uphill Landing - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 6
clips.what: Same jump/landing, D1 flame jets at +2.5s, hard cut at +3.0s to the tightest camera state (bike ~40% of frame height) as the rider sits stationary at C2 and blips the throttle (exhaust puffs at +4.5s). Reference for the stationary/tight framing and lens flare.

clips.source_title: Uphill Landing - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 6
clips.what: Rider falls off the plank at +0.5s, ragdoll hits the mattress at +1.7s, rider and bike come to rest while the camera slowly settles (+2..+5s), single-frame hard cut to checkpoint B3 at +5.1s (no fade), riding again by +5.5s.

clips.source_title: Flat Obstacles - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 9
clips.what: Ride up onto a giant cable spool, tip over the far side at +2.0s, rider thrown clear of the bike and lands on the D3 platform (+2.5..+4.3s), hard cut to D3 checkpoint at +4.5s, idle at checkpoint.

clips.source_title: Flat Obstacles - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 9
clips.what: Wait at D3 (0-2s), roll in, hop onto the spool at +2.5s; camera zooms to tight during the slow section (+3..+4s); rear-wheel lift and roll over the spool (+4.5..+6.5s); reset at +7s.

clips.source_title: Flat Obstacles - Trials Rising In-game Lesson 9
clips.what: Land on the A1 zone with flame-jet pyro (+0.5..+1s), reposition, then a series of small front-wheel lifts and hops on a plank against a box (+3..+5.5s).

Skill-game start: '3' at +0.5s, '2' at +1.5s, '1' at +2.5s, 'GO!' at +3.5s (1.0s cadence, each numeral fades in ~0.5s), tip text hides at GO, rider lifts the front wheel immediately and the camera widens as speed builds.
Sustained wheelie through the 50 m gate over bumps and 'SAFE ZONE' pads; HUD distance 36.0 m -> 62.7 m over 6.5 s (~4.1 m/s); pitch ~30-45 deg with visible correction oscillation.

Rider holds a stationary wheelie on a steep ramp for ~3.4 s (distance frozen at 116.373 m), front wheel touches, bomb detonates at +3.75s: orange fireball full size in 0.25s, 'CRASH!' label at detonation, 'TRACK FINISHED!' banner +0.4s later, white smoke cloud by +0.75s, ragdoll flung.

Rider drops off the start ledge (in-game timer 00:00.8) and lands rear-wheel-first on the raised near end of a plank seesaw at +1.5s; the plank stays pinned nose-up (~35 deg) while the rider crawls up it toward the pivot post (+2.5..+5.5s, rider standing, hanging forward over the bars); once the front wheel passes the pivot at ~+5.8s the plank tips over in ~0.5s and the bike rides down the far side; rider bails off the low end at +6.8s and hard-cut resets to the start (blue respawn tint) at +7.0s.

Two starts back to back. Rider rear-wheel hops on the start ledge (respawn shader still glowing blue, 0-1.3s), drops ~2 bike heights and lands on the seesaw's raised end at +2.5s with the plank already tilted toward him; pitches back and drives up to the pivot (+3.5..+5.2s), the plank tips at +5.5s and the rider is on the down-slope by +5.8s; hard-cut reset to the start at +6.0s (timer 00:00.000), second rear-wheel hop and drop at +7.3s. Reference for the 'wait for the plank, then commit' timing.

clips.technique: stairs / big steps (drop-in and first hops)
clips.source_title: Trials Fusion: Completing The Impossible Stairs
clips.what: Rider launches off the checkpoint platform at +0.3s (5 faults, timer 01:28.7), ~1.5s of airtime with the camera pulling back to its widest state, lands two steps down the giant staircase at +2.0s, then hops step to step (each step ~1 bike length deep, ~1 bike height tall) with a rear-wheel-first landing on each tread; the headlight blooms white toward the camera each time the bike pitches back (+4.2, +5.2, +6.7s).

clips.source_title: Trials Fusion: Completing The Impossible Stairs
clips.what: Continuous hop-down of the staircase, timer 01:36.2 -> 01:43.2: roughly one step every 1.5-2 s, each step a short rear-wheel hop (bike pitched 40-60 deg nose-up at takeoff, headlight bloom at the apex), front wheel dropped onto the next tread, settle ~0.5 s, repeat. Camera keeps the bike at ~30% x and the tread edge line runs diagonally across the frame; background pylons drift left by ~1/3 of the frame over the clip.
